_comment: Dialogue move catalog (gdd-npc-dialogue.md §5.2). Phase 1 = converse/ask_rumor/influence_*/provoke/farewell. Phase 2 (Transactions) ADDED ask_question, offer_bribe, offer_terms, offer_hire_henchman/specialist/mercenary, gather_information. Phase 3 (The World Stage) ADDS: the Q-5 QUEST/RUMOR ADAPTER block (quest_ask/quest_accept/quest_decline/quest_turn_in; ask_rumor's stub body swapped for the real registry) and the ACTION-REQUEST block (request_action; persuade_ruler; the army-parley demand set demand_surrender/demand_tribute/offer_passage/offer_terms_parley; use_ability; negotiate_surrender). These two blocks are kept clearly separated below. This JSON is the action-vocabulary registration site for dialogue moves (no formal action_vocabulary.gd per conventions §10.1; moves are data-defined per §5.1).

moves.label: Converse
moves.notes: Small talk; no roll. Feeds memory; may surface knowledge marked freely (Phase 2+).

moves.label: Ask for Rumor
moves.notes: Phase 1 uses a STUB rumor pool (no live quest/rumor system yet, Wave 0 sequencing). Requires attitude >= Neutral (§5.2).

moves.label: Persuade (Diplomatic)
moves.notes: InteractionResolver.resolve_attempt_to_influence, diplomatic tone (ax_reactions:74-149).

moves.label: Intimidate
moves.notes: Intimidation tone (ax_reactions:151-241); Fearful/Cowed substitutions. Result 2 -> combat. Blocked when the speaker is charmed by the interlocutor (§5.6).

moves.label: Seduce
moves.notes: Seduction tone (ax_reactions:243-324); NPC must be flagged receptive.

moves.label: Provoke
moves.notes: No roll to anger: attitude shifts 1 step toward Hostile per use (PROJECT CALL). On reaching Hostile, NPC attacks immediately (acore_adventures:952-954). Blocked when the speaker is charmed by the interlocutor (§5.6).

moves.label: Ask a Question
moves.notes: Willingness gate (§9.1): freely shares at Neutral+; if_trusted needs Friendly/Cowed; if_paid spawns offer_terms; never refuses (no fabricated lie in Phase 2). Reads characters.personality.knowledge; tolerates empty.

moves.label: Offer a Bribe
moves.notes: Bribery-style +1..+3 modifier (ax_reactions:96) to the NEXT influence attempt this session; gold escrowed; memory bribed; reputation risk hook.

moves.label: Offer Terms
moves.notes: Sets the ±1 situational modifier (acore_equipment:672-676) + recorded terms on the pending dependent (hire, if_paid knowledge). Persists to npc_issues.terms.

moves.label: Offer to Hire (Henchman)
moves.notes: Wraps HenchmanLifecycleManager.attempt_hire as an interview (§11.1). Try-Again loops through offer_terms; Accept -> finalize_hire; Refuse-and-slander -> settlement -1 (§11.4).

moves.label: Offer to Hire (Specialist)
moves.notes: Named specialists (sages/engineers/spellcasters) hire at flat fees + faith surcharges (acore_equipment:975-978). Dialogue is the value-add scene; routine hires keep the panel flow (§11.2).

moves.label: Offer to Hire (Mercenary)
moves.notes: Market-scale; reaction per company (daw_armies_recruitment:89-90). Dialogue negotiates a captain / an encountered armed band (acore_adventures:960-962). Bulk recruitment stays in the market UI (§11.3).

moves.label: Gather Information
moves.notes: Settlement Gather-Information entry (§4.2). Dual path: a short session with a generated Tier-C interlocutor OR menu quick-resolve. Q-5 wires the real RumorRegistry when injected via context.deps.rumor_registry; else stub-tolerant.

moves.label: Ask About Work
moves.notes: QuestRegistry.offerable_quests(npc_id, party_id, attitude). Attitude-gated (§9.3): Friendly unlocks personal-posting; Neutral only posted/broadcast. Emits quest_offered per surfaced quest. Hidden when the NPC has no offerable quests (has_offerable_quests gate).

moves.label: Accept the Quest
moves.notes: QuestRegistry.accept(quest_id, pc_id, calendar_day). params: {quest_id, pc_id}. Emits quest_accepted. Surfaces only when a quest was offered this session.

moves.label: Decline the Quest
moves.notes: QuestRegistry.decline(quest_id, party_id). params: {quest_id}. No status change; dialogue records the decline memory. Emits quest_declined.

moves.label: Turn In the Quest
moves.notes: QuestRegistry.can_turn_in then disburse_reward(quest_id, recipient_pc_id) with reward-recipient selection (§9.6). params: {quest_id, recipient_pc_id}. Emits quest_turned_in.

moves.label: Ask a Favor of Consequence
moves.notes: §10.1 matrix. params: {action_id (must be in requestable_actions), terms?}. Attitude gate -> PerIssueResolver -> deterministic handoff to the owning subsystem -> EventScheduler carries deferred completion. Unknown action_id rejected (rule 10.2). Surfaces only when requestable_actions(npc) is non-empty; per-row min_attitude refines the gate.

moves.label: Petition the Ruler
moves.notes: §10.3 Seam B. params: packet {target_action_id (RulerActionCatalog), direction dissuade|urge, terms, expires_after_months}. Deterministic persuasion_strength; dissuade cancels/postpones scheduled events; urge (v1 defensive/economic only) biases utility. Routes through RulerStrategyReassessor.apply_validated (validation NOT relaxed). Surfaces only in a ruler audience.

moves.label: Demand Surrender
moves.notes: §10.4. Intimidation per-issue; ArmyParleyResolver stacks RAW evidence from real BR/morale/loss-of-face/siege. Success cancels battle events + schedules withdrawal; roll of 2 collapses to immediate battle. Dialogue never touches battle math.

moves.label: Demand Tribute
moves.notes: §10.4. As demand_surrender; success schedules tribute collection. params: {tribute_gp}.

moves.label: Offer Safe Passage
moves.notes: §10.4. Diplomatic per-issue with favors/authority lines. Success schedules withdrawal.

moves.label: Offer Terms (Parley)
moves.notes: §10.4. Diplomatic parley terms (distinct id from the transaction offer_terms so gating/dispatch stay unambiguous). Success schedules withdrawal.

moves.label: Use an Ability
moves.notes: §5.5. params: {capability_id, target_pc_id?/target_npc?}. Player-side dialogue-usable ability (charm/esp/detect/cure). Non-social casting mid-dialogue = combat (session terminates with outcome combat). Gated by real availability (player_capabilities non-empty).

moves.label: Negotiate Surrender Terms
moves.notes: §12.2 post-combat surrender re-entry. Diplomatic per-issue resolving ransom/terms with survivors who yielded (attitude seeded Fearful/Cowed). params: {ransom_gp?}.

moves.label: Farewell
moves.notes: Terminal; triggers COMMIT (§4.4 step 8).
